decisions.reason: The public launch announcement and centrality to identity storage signal high commitment and investment, making management reluctant to write off the effort.
Despite only a website mention, the payment wallet aligns with the firm's secure payment direction and likely involved substantial investment, so escalation leads to keeping it.
The NFC authenticator has only a brief website mention, indicating low investment and little public commitment, so management is more willing to drop it when results are weak.
A dedicated website page and its role in payment/wallet frameworks reflect visible commitment and strategic centrality, making discontinuation unlikely.
As the core multi-service app platform central to the firm's announced direction, dropping it would contradict the firm's public positioning and write off major investment.
Its dedicated page and fit with the firm's application-security expertise create enough commitment to keep it, though less centrality than the platform yields a slightly higher drop probability.
